title: Ammonium Valerianicum
text: This remedy is characterized by its action on the nervous system. It is especially useful in cases of nervous disorders and hysteria. There is a general feeling of agitation and restlessness. It is also useful in cases of headaches and insomnia in nervous people. Nervous and agitated. Restless. Irritable. Insomnia. Neuralgic pains in the head. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Appetite poor. Nausea. Flatulence. Compare: Valeriana; Kali bromatum; Ignatia. Third to sixth potency.
